title: OpenAI Structured Outputs / function calling with strict: true
applies_to: function tools sent with strict: true (Chat Completions and Responses API)

rules.title: Root schema must be type object
rules.rationale: The root level of a schema must be an object.

rules.title: Root schema must not use anyOf
rules.rationale: The root level object of a schema must not use anyOf (for example a discriminated union).

rules.title: Objects must set additionalProperties: false
rules.rationale: additionalProperties: false must always be set in objects. Setting it narrows free-form objects (dict[str, Any]) to empty objects.

rules.title: All properties must be listed in required
rules.rationale: All fields must be required; optional fields are emulated with a union with null. The rewrite makes them required-and-nullable, so the server must treat null like an omitted argument.

rules.title: Unsupported composition keywords
rules.rationale: Not yet supported: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else.

rules.title: String format outside the documented list
rules.rationale: Documented formats: date-time, time, date, duration, email, hostname, ipv4, ipv6, uuid.

rules.title: At most 10 levels of object nesting
rules.rationale: A schema may have up to 5000 object properties total, with up to 10 levels of nesting.

rules.title: At most 5000 object properties in total
rules.rationale: A schema may have up to 5000 object properties total.

rules.title: At most 1000 enum values in total
rules.rationale: A schema may have up to 1000 enum values across all enum properties.
